第69章 获得一块电瓶-《赶山1957：二斤猪肉换个媳妇》

早餐店的前面是门店，后面是居住的房子，不过即使是土乡这种乡镇里面的房子，也没几间砖瓦房，都是土胚房，就是比农村居住密度高一些，贩子多了一些，乡政府，乡诊所这些机构聚集，造就了一些繁华。

“青山！”

黄韵将钱递到李青山手中，眼波流转，纤细的手指划过李青山的手心道：“你这名字倒是好听，比那些狗剩，铁蛋，二毛的好听多了。”

“咦，韵姐，你这电瓶哪来的？”就在这时，李青山突然发现房间角落内的一个电瓶，眼中闪过一抹精光道。

“你说这个？”

“我家弟弟是汽车维修队的，这个是他拿回来的，说是没什么用了，暂且在这里放着。”

“咋了？”

黄韵开口问道。

“韵姐，你这个电瓶要是不怎么用的话，能不能卖给我？”李青山一脸期待的朝着黄韵望了过去道。

“说什么卖啊？”

“多外道！”

“这样，你跟姐生个孩子，这电瓶姐就送你了。”

黄韵突然凑了过来，弯着腰抬头望着近在咫尺的李青山，语气中满是媚语道。

“啥？”

李青山一惊，脸上流露出一抹惊讶之色！

这，这进展这么快的吗？

这小娘们，也太猛了吧？

“咯咯，逗你玩呢！”

见李青山一脸惊讶的模样，黄韵轻笑一声道：“这电瓶我也不知道价，你给个数吧！”

“这电瓶应该是国产的，新的大概八十块钱到一百块钱，二手的应该是在二十块钱到四十块钱，主要是看成色，这个电瓶看起来还是比较新的，要不就四十块钱吧，怎么样？”

李青山摆弄着角落内还算比较新的电瓶，开口道。

现在的电瓶国产的便宜，进口的就贵一些，是国产的两倍价格。

“这东西这么贵的？”黄韵微微一怔，倒也没想到这电瓶价格这么贵。

四十块钱，这可是一笔巨款啊！

“韵姐，你能做主不，要不先问一问你弟弟？”李青山再次道。

“不用，他说过用不上了，等他来的时候我把钱给他就是了。”黄韵道。

“行，韵姐！”

In front of the breakfast shop is the store, and behind it are residential houses. However, even in towns like Tuxiang, there are only a few brick houses. They are all mud houses. The living density is higher than in rural areas, and there are more dealers. The concentration of institutions such as township governments and township clinics has created some prosperity.

"Qingshan!"

Huang Yun handed the money to Li Qingshan's hand, her eyes moved, her slender fingers crossed Li Qingshan's palm and said: "Your name sounds nice, much nicer than those Gou Sheng, Tiedan, Ermao."

"Hey, Sister Yun, where did you get this battery?" At this moment, Li Qingshan suddenly found a battery in the corner of the room and said with a flash of light in his eyes.

"You mean this?"

"My younger brother works in the automobile maintenance team. He brought this back and said it was of no use anymore, so he will keep it here for now."

"What's wrong?"

Huang Yun asked.

"Sister Yun, if you don't use this battery very much, can you sell it to me?" Li Qingshan looked at Huang Yun expectantly and asked.

"What are you selling?"

"What a heretic!"

"In this way, if you and sister have a child, the battery sister will give it to you."

Huang Yun suddenly came over, bent over and looked up at Li Qingshan who was close at hand, her tone was full of flattery.

"What?"

Li Qingshan was startled, with a look of surprise on his face!

Is this progressing so quickly?

This little girl is too fierce, isn't she?

"Giggle, I'm teasing you!"

Seeing Li Qingshan's surprised look, Huang Yun chuckled and said, "I don't know the price of this battery, please give me an estimate!"

"This battery should be made in China. A new one costs about 80 to 100 yuan. A second-hand one should cost 20 to 40 yuan. It mainly depends on the quality. This battery looks relatively new. How about it cost 40 yuan?"

Li Qingshan fiddled with the relatively new battery in the corner and said.

Nowadays, domestically produced batteries are cheaper, while imported batteries are more expensive, twice the price of domestically produced batteries.

"Is this thing so expensive?" Huang Yun was slightly startled, but she didn't expect the battery to be so expensive.

Forty yuan, this is a huge amount of money!

"Sister Yun, can you make the decision? Why don't you ask your brother first?" Li Qingshan said again.

"No, he said he won't need it anymore. I'll just give him the money when he comes." Huang Yun said.

"Okay, Sister Yun!"
